confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings, booking pages, or price sources were checked. Restaurant food anchors are moderately reliable; beer, hostel, and hotel rates vary widely by area and season, and July is usually a quiet, very hot month in Marrakech. Cocktail and wine were derived from beer using local price relationships because direct knowledge is weak (cocktail about 2.5 times beer; wine glass about 1.5 times beer). FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page for 13 October 2026; I did not open that page or the RBA CSV directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: North African tourist pricing, benchmarked loosely against other Moroccan destinations such as Fez, with Marrakech placed above Fez for tourist-facing restaurants, bars, and riad or hotel rooms. No single comparable city was used.
